previews.title: Live preview
previews.explain: Runs the code of a release (or a scanned snapshot of the staging) in a temporary, isolated container on a private URL. Nothing goes live.
previews.limits: Data read-only (uploads, caches and file sessions fail), no database unless you ask for a copy, no mail, Internet like the site, secret environment variables hidden. Staging snapshots are scanned first.
previews.replaces: Replaces the running preview of this site.
previews.shareHint: One-shot link, valid 10 minutes, through a confirmation page.
previews.stopConfirm: Stop the preview and delete its container?
previews.envAll: Pass every environment variable, secrets included
previews.envAllHint: Real side effects possible (payments, external APIs).
previews.allowBlockedScan: Run code blocked by the analysis (staff, audited)

warnings.scanWarnings: The analysis reported findings: check them before publishing.
warnings.dataReadOnly: Data paths are read-only: uploads, caches and file sessions fail.
warnings.ephemeralSkipped: Some ephemeral data paths could not get a temporary folder.
warnings.noDatabase: No database is connected: pages that need it fail.
warnings.secretsHidden: Secret environment variables are not passed.
warnings.egressAllowed: The preview reaches the Internet like the site (external APIs with real credentials included).
warnings.selfSignedCertificate: Self-signed certificate: the browser asks for an exception.
warnings.notSegmented: The account network is not segmented: the preview reaches the other containers of the account like the site.
warnings.dbCloneProductionData: The database is a copy of production taken at start: real data, every write lost at stop.

errorCodes.publishInProgress: A publication was running: try again.
errorCodes.previewBuildFailed: The preview could not be built.
errorCodes.dbCloneTooLarge: The databases are too large to be copied.
errorCodes.dbCloneExited: The server of the database copy stopped.
errorCodes.dbIsolationLost: A database server became reachable through a published port (external access): preview stopped.
errorCodes.previewDbCloneDisabled: Database copies are disabled on this platform.
errorCodes.previewDbInstanceNotRunning: The database server is not running.
errorCodes.instanceBusy: The database server was busy (backup, export…): try again.

settings.title: Release previews
settings.explain: Live previews of a release or of the staging, on the preview domain (needs a preview domain).
settings.minIntervalSeconds: Minimum delay between two previews of a site (s)
settings.dbCloneHint: A preview may get a throw-away copy of the site's database(s), in memory, on a network of its own: the live database is never reachable. The copy counts in the memory of the host while the preview runs.

db.cloneHint: A throw-away copy of the site's database(s), taken now from a consistent export: same names, users and passwords, so the site connects unchanged. The live database is never reachable from the preview.
db.warning: The copy holds production data: whoever opens the preview sees it. Every write is lost when the preview stops; mail stays off.
db.title: Database copy
db.rotated: Random password in the copy for {{users}} (their real one is a secret variable).
